name: Starlit Anemone

yarn.description: Fine cotton or cotton-blend yarn for petals
Fine cotton or cotton-blend yarn for centre

additional_materials: Small pins and blocking mat, optional

abbreviations.hdc dec: half double crochet decrease: work 2 hdc together
abbreviations.bobble: 4-dc bobble: work 4 partial dc in one stitch, then close all loops
abbreviations.inc: increase: work 2 sc in the same stitch

gauge: Gauge is not critical because this is a decorative flower. Use a firm tension so the centre holds its shape.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With centre yarn, make an MR. Ch 1, work 6 sc in the MR, then join with sl st to the first sc.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Ch 1, inc in each sc around. Join with sl st to the first sc.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: Ch 1, *sc in next stitch, bobble in next stitch; rep from * 5 more times. Push each bobble to the right side. Join with sl st to the first sc.

steps.label: Row 1
steps.text: Sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch. Turn.

steps.label: Row 2
steps.text: Ch 2, work 2 dc in first stitch, dc in next stitch, 2 dc in last stitch. Turn.

steps.label: Row 3
steps.text: Ch 2, work 2 dc in first stitch, dc in each of the next 3 stitches, 2 dc in last stitch. Turn.

steps.label: Row 4
steps.text: Ch 2, work 2 dc in first stitch, dc in each of the next 5 stitches, 2 dc in last stitch. Turn.

steps.label: Row 5
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each stitch across. Turn.

steps.label: Row 6
steps.text: Ch 2, hdc dec over first 2 stitches, hdc in each of the next 5 stitches, hdc dec over last 2 stitches. Turn.

steps.label: Row 7
steps.text: Ch 2, hdc dec over first 2 stitches, hdc in each of the next 3 stitches, hdc dec over last 2 stitches. Turn.

steps.label: Row 8
steps.text: Ch 2, hdc dec over first 2 stitches, hdc in next stitch, hdc dec over last 2 stitches. Turn.

steps.label: Row 9
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each stitch across. Leave the working loop in place for fastening off.

assembly: Fasten off each petal as described in Finishing, retaining its 20 cm yarn tail. Place the centre right side up, with the bobbles facing front.
Position one petal behind each sc from Rnd 3 of the centre. Arrange the 3-stitch Row 1 edge of every petal against the centre so the petals radiate evenly.
Using each petal's retained tail, sew through all 3 stitches of its Row 1 edge and through the corresponding sc of Rnd 3. Secure each petal with two small stitches on the reverse side.
finishing: Fasten off the centre after Rnd 3, leaving a 10 cm tail. Fasten off each petal after Row 9, leaving a 20 cm tail: cut yarn, pull the tail through the final loop, and tighten.
After assembly, weave the centre tail and all petal sewing tails through nearby reverse-side stitches. Trim the tails close without cutting the fabric.
Lightly block the petals into a gentle open cup shape. Pin the petals evenly, mist lightly if suitable for the yarn, and allow them to dry completely.
notes: Turning chains do not count as stitches throughout.

To make a bobble, yo, insert hook in the indicated stitch, yo and pull up a loop, yo and pull through 2 loops. Rep this partial dc 3 more times in the same stitch, then yo and pull through all 5 loops on the hook.
